title: PCR Using Q5U Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7schnaw
materials: Q5U Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase

steps.title: Prepare the PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction using the specified components for either a 25 µl or 50 µl total volume.

substeps.instruction: Add 5X Q5U Reaction Buffer (5 µl for 25 µl reaction; 10 µl for 50 µl reaction; final conc. 1X)
Add 10 mM dNTPs (0.5 µl for 25 µl reaction; 1 µl for 50 µl reaction; final conc. 200 µM)
Add 10 µM Forward Primer (1.25 µl for 25 µl reaction; 2.5 µl for 50 µl reaction; final conc. 0.5 µM)
Add 10 µM Reverse Primer (1.25 µl for 25 µl reaction; 2.5 µl for 50 µl reaction; final conc. 0.5 µM)
Add Template DNA (variable amount; final conc. < 1,000 ng)
Add Q5U Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (0.25 µl for 25 µl reaction; 0.5 µl for 50 µl reaction; final conc. 0.02 U/µl)
Add Nuclease-Free Water to reach final volume of 25 µl or 50 µl

steps.title: Mix and prepare samples
steps.instruction: Ensure the reaction is homogeneous and sealed.

substeps.instruction: Quick spin the tubes to collect all liquid at the bottom.
Overlay the sample with mineral oil if the PCR machine does not have a heated lid.

steps.title: Perform thermocycling
steps.instruction: Transfer tubes to the PCR machine and run the following program (no separate activation step required).

substeps.instruction: 30 Cycles of: 98°C for 5-10 seconds, 55–72°C for 20 seconds, and 72°C for 20-30 seconds/kb
